# Benchmark photographs

Place the 44 photographs listed in benchmark-44.json here, named exactly as `photo.photo_path` says (and the two follow-up photographs). Phone-camera JPEGs at the PWA size (about 1280px, ~82% quality), ordinary room light, handheld. This directory is intentionally empty in the repository until the founder supplies them; `node scripts/market-benchmark.mjs --readiness` lists what is missing and records SHA-256 hashes in photo-hashes.json.
